description: Public local-inference-lab Qwen3.8 Flash Next NVFP4 checkpoint (MXFP8 attention, NVFP4 experts and PLE table, about 99 GiB), sized for one 121 GiB Spark; the origin of the Mia-AiLab mirror this family was catalogued from (that repository returns HTTP 401 since 2026-10-03), with every weight, configuration and tokenizer file byte-identical. The base model Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next is under the Qwen Community License 1.0 (attribution and Model-as-a-Service conditions for commercial use).
